selftext: It's for my game you will have to search my profile cus im not allowed to post it here for some reason, even though its free

replies.author: Accomplished-Fan9568
replies.body: basically i use both claude and gemini 3.1 pro to create a 3d model in a html doc for me, I try both to see which one i prefer, then i ask it to animate the the different movements. If the legs or something is off i ask it to build a pose editor with sliders to tweak them, then output the positions in a text export box, copy that and feed it back to the LLM.

comments.author: MilkLover090
comments.body:
i just dont get the appeal of this

if you were generating triple a standard models, that would be understanable because that level of quality is basically unachievable for indie devs (unless buying assets)

but this, simply low poly models. Can easily by hand crafted by anyone after watching a couple hours of tutorials.

I just dont get it, whenever i use ai for code i get no satisfaction out of it

making your own art for games is incredibly rewarding, why would you rob yourself of that?

replies.author: Accomplished-Fan9568
replies.body:
It's not so much about the model itself, but rather AI being able to animate the movement... walking, crouching. In fact it can apply slerp in between those movements to make smooth transitions.

This is a big jump from what we previously could do.

https://i.redd.it/2oqd5bzpl1og1.gif
